description: This file defines the CrcCordState class, a copy-on-write data structure used internally in the Abseil library for managing chunked CRC32C data, supporting efficient substring operations and state management.

classes.name: CrcCordState
classes.description: A copy-on-write class that manages chunked CRC32C data for efficient substring operations.

methods.name: Checksum
methods.description: Returns the CRC32C checksum of the entire Cord.

methods.name: IsNormalized
methods.description: Checks if the CRC32C cache is normalized (no removed prefix).

methods.name: Normalize
methods.description: Normalizes the CRC32C checksum cache by subtracting any removed prefix.

methods.name: NumChunks
methods.description: Returns the number of cached CRC chunks.

methods.name: NormalizedPrefixCrcAtNthChunk
methods.description: Returns the (length, crc) pair of the specified cached chunk.

methods.name: Poison
methods.description: Poisons all chunks to likely produce an incorrect checksum.
